intervention: Same isolated H3 recovery change; no additional runtime change. Assess broader ordinary corpus behavior and current Light versus integrated Cline efficiency. Without recovery activation, ordinary arm variation is not attributed causally to H3.
taskSelection: All 25 existing corpus tasks, selected before this campaign outcomes. Six inspected in previous pilots are diagnostics; other 19 were not used to choose H3 but are not claimed historically unseen. This internal corpus is not the historical external 18-task campaign.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, pinned installed dependencies, fresh identical fixture per paired task; no memory or solution retrieval. Provider nondeterminism, retries and cache are uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Existing production estimate guard BLAME_AGENT_MAX_SESSION_COST_USD and fixed task/outer deadlines. Stop starting trials at observed USD 1.80; retain unexecuted planned trials, timeouts and missing usage. These are not invoice caps. Separate from the preceding panel, whose observed cost was USD 0.18105876.

ordering: Fixed manifest order in repetition one; reverse tasks and cyclic arm order in repetition two. Sequential; no trial replacement or optional stopping for favorable outcomes.
quality: Primary expanded independent instruction audit with original checks plus required post-edit build and navigation/order obligations. Apply the already selected old-handler-after-clear replay to all webhook solutions; no solution repair. Preserve original score-100 success, functional success, admitted validation, audit and runtime status separately. Audit every input and diff; native proof fields not required.
accounting: Only compare efficiency with comparable audited quality; report full-panel success/failure resources and paired both-success subsets separately. Reconcile input/output/estimated cost to observed SDK events; cache/request and interrupted usage missingness retained. No historical pooling or zero imputation. Report raw paired differences and task-level uncertainty; no gain selected by swapping tasks or excluding failures.
decision: One fixed broad campaign, irrespective of outcome. Compare modified with reference and integrated Cline, separately for six known diagnostics and 19 confirmation tasks. No causal H3 efficiency claim without mechanism activation; synthetic outage evidence cannot establish an ordinary population gain.
